'''J'oopi Shé''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] allied with the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]], a secret organization within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]; Master Shé was also a member of the Order's [[Technical division/Legends|technical division]].

==Biography==
[[File:JediTempleHallway-ROTS.png|thumb|left|250px|Master J'oopi Shé and Jedi [[Melik Galerha/Legends|Melik Galerha]] leave a briefing together.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]], J'oopi Shé was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Raised at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Shé trained as a [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]], crafting a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] before attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Earning a place in the Order's [[Technical division/Legends|technical division]], Master Shé was stationed on Coruscant throughout the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] when he came to be associated with the secret organization calling itself the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]].<ref name="MF" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Shé took up the mantle of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], largely serving on Coruscant throughout the war. As part of his work with the Republic Group, Master Shé associated himself with [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Des'sein]] and [[Largetto]] and began to take part in their efforts to restore the Republic.<ref name="MF" />

When the war [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|came to Coruscant]], Master Shé aided the Republic thwart the Separatist forces on the planet, later attending a briefing given by Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at the Temple.<ref name="ROTS" /> Immediately before that briefing, Master Shé accompanied Senators Des'sein and Largetto as they met with the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']] which was docked at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]].<ref name="MF" />

As the ship's cargo was unloaded, Master Shé installed a transponder of unusual design in the ship's holds; Captain [[Tobb Jadak]] was told an [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] named [[Aren Folee|Folee]] would know what to do with the transponder when it arrived at its destination. During the meeting, the Senators and the Jedi were unaware they were being watched by members of the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]]. When [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] made the decision to arrest all members of the Republic Group, Master Shé was forced to take the Senators to a safer place as Captain Jadak and the ''Stellar Envoy'' were pursued by [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]].<ref name="MF" /> After escorting the Senators to safety, Master Shé returned to hear Kenobi's report at the Temple.<ref name="ROTS" />
